The '''Stalker Den''' is a cave located beneath the [[Custodia Pass]]. Limited access to the den is gained during [[Shadows of Custodia]] quest, but full access to the area and monsters requires its full completion.

It is inhabited by [[Custodian stalker]]s, of which there are three main types: [[Juvenile custodian stalker|juvenile]], [[Mature custodian stalker|mature]], and [[Elder custodian stalker|elder Custodian stalkers]], requiring 54, 67 and 76 [[Slayer]] in order to be harmed, respectively. [[Baby custodian stalker|Baby custodian stalkers]] also wander the caves but cannot be attacked. A book called ''[[On Migration Patterns]]'' and a [[noose wand]] can be found near a [[Corpse (Shadows of Custodia)|corpse]] in the western section of the cave.

[[Ancient Zygomite]]s and [[Rod Fishing spot (lure, bait)|rod fishing spots]] can be found around the spring in the centre of the dungeon. With level 64 [[Agility]], a [[Stepping stone (Stalker Den)|stepping stone]] can be used to cross the water and quickly reach the elder Custodian stalkers in the north.

The south-western sections of the dungeon are entirely [[Multicombat area|multicombat]], and [[Dwarf multicannon|cannons]] can be placed, while two caves in the south-east and two in the north are [[single-way combat]].

==Transportation==
The den has two entrances:

*[[Cave (Stalker Den)|Southern entrance]] requiring 59 [[Agility]] ({{Map|x=1325|y=3364|text=Show map|type=maplink|mtype=pin|title=Southern entrance|zoom=3}})
**[[Quetzal Transport System|Quetzal]] to [[Auburnvale]], run west then north.
**After activating the [[Statue of Ates]], use the [[Pendant of Ates]] to go to Nemus Retreat then run north.
**[[Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|AIS}} to [[Auburn Valley]], then run north-west.
*Northern entrance ({{Map|x=1296|y=3374|text=Show map|type=maplink|mtype=pin|title=Northern entrance|zoom=3}})
**[[Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|BLS}} to [[Kebos Lowlands]], then run south to the pass, then take the rowboat across the lake, then enter the cave south east.
**Use [[Xeric's Talisman]] to [[Mount Quidamortem|Xeric's Honour]], descending to South of Quidamortem with the [[Mountain Guide]], then running south.
